text:
Sam (support): Heads-up: AcmeCorp escalated — seeing 502s + latency spikes during a canary rollout of gpt-redwood-2.3 on Dedicated. Need repro artifacts (req IDs, curl, debug bundle). Any immediate mitigations?

Priya (oncall): pinging @eng-runtime @eng-ml. Can you share example request IDs and approximate times so we can map to traces? :eyes:

Sam (support): Provided below — all from 2026-03-16 15:12-15:18 UTC. Request IDs: rQ-20260316-9a1b2c3d, rQ-20260316-9a1b2c3e, rQ-20260316-9a1b2c3f. Client reports reproducible with small prompt. Example curl I asked them to try:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-2.3","input":"Summarize: The deployment test.","max_tokens":64}' \
  --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 30 -v
```

Sam (support): Also asked customer to run `rdx-support collect-debug --req rQ-20260316-9a1b2c3d --out acme-debug.tgz` and attach. They said attaching now.

SRE-Bot: debug bundle upload received: acme-debug-1845678.tgz (size: 12.1MB). Trace ID mapping created: rQ-20260316-9a1b2c3d -> trace-0a7f4c.

Kai (eng-ml): Quick read — initial flame graphs look like a kernel selection mismatch for the new quantized path. Two clarifying Qs: (1) Was the rollout using the quantized variant (v2.3-q4) or standard FP16 (v2.3-fp16)? (2) Any customer-side model pinning?

Sam (support): Customer says they did not pin. Console rollout: candidate -> 5% at 15:05 UTC -> 50% at 15:14 UTC -> errors start ~15:16. They increased traffic while kernel warmups were still happening.

Mateo (eng-runtime): From runtime logs in bundle (excerpt):

```
[15:16:02] worker-7 ERROR handler.go:187 response write failed: 502 empty response, upstream err: runtime panic: invalid memory address or nil pointer deref
[15:16:02] worker-7 TRACE trace.go:42 traceID=trace-0a7f4c reqID=rQ-20260316-9a1b2c3d model=gpt-redwood-2.3 variant=v2.3-q4 kernel=auto
[15:16:03] poolmgr WARN pool.go:112 allocation delay=312ms pending=8
```

Mateo (eng-runtime): Looks like variant=v2.3-q4 attempted but kernel auto-selection fell back to an incompatible path mid-request. That aligns with the quantization change Kai mentioned.

Kai (eng-ml): Agreed. Likely regression from the new fused-attn kernel when sequence-length/profile mix is different during gradual traffic ramp. Repro plan: 1) run the exact curl with the same input and concurrency (we need load profile), 2) force variant selection to non-quantized to confirm mitigates, 3) collect perf counters + core dumps if it fails.

Sam (support): Customer can run single-shot and small burst. They said 8 concurrent requests reproduces. Asking them to run both: single request and 8 concurrency with same payload.

Priya (oncall): Actionable mitigation right now: pin requests to stable variant until we have a fix. Two ways: (A) Instruct customer to explicitly set model param to `gpt-redwood-2.2` in their calls; (B) within Console -> Deployments, roll the canary back to 0% (pause) or pin traffic to stable. Which is easier for the account?

Jenna (acmecorp): We want minimal disruption. We can change the model param on our side for now. How do we pin to gpt-redwood-2.2 via API?

Sam (support): Use the same endpoint and set "model":"gpt-redwood-2.2" in the payload. Example: `-d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-2.2",...}'`. That will route to stable and avoid the q4 kernel. If you want us to roll back the canary, we can do that from our side — tell me and I'll schedule immediate rollback.

Jenna (acmecorp): We'll flip to gpt-redwood-2.2 on our side for the next hour and confirm. Please keep investigating.

Mateo (eng-runtime): Meanwhile we'll triage logs and replicate locally. Kai, can you try to reproduce with our internal stress harness using the exact payload + concurrency 8? I'll attach the bundle to the ticket and run with the same binary/environment.

Kai (eng-ml): On it. Also need the model-variant manifest (from model catalog) for v2.3-q4 — Sam can you attach the variant id from the debug bundle metadata?

Sam (support): Attached: variant-id: mv-2.3-q4-20260315-8f7e. Also attaching customer's console rollout screenshot (5% -> 50%).

Kai (eng-ml): Thanks. If we can repro, plan is: short-term patch to reject kernel auto-switchover for that variant; medium-term patch to fix fused-attn under mixed-profile; then a coordinated canary re-roll.

Priya (oncall): Can we add an automatic fallback rule to prefer stable when `poolmgr pending > 5`? That would avoid partial kernel warmup causing 502s during traffic spikes.

Mateo (eng-runtime): We have a routing policy feature. I'll propose a temp policy: if allocation delay > 200ms AND pool pending > 3 -> route to fallback model variant (stable). Not sure we can apply per-customer immediately, but we can flip cluster-wide if needed.

Sam (support): Action items:
- Sam: coordinate with AcmeCorp to keep them on gpt-redwood-2.2 and collect confirmation (owner: Sam)
- Priya: keep oncall in loop and escalate infra if we see cluster-wide regressions (owner: Priya)
- Kai: reproduce locally with stress harness and triage kernel path (owner: Kai)
- Mateo: prepare a short-term routing policy to prefer stable on allocation delays, and gather runtime metrics + core dumps (owner: Mateo)

Jenna (acmecorp): Confirmed: switched to gpt-redwood-2.2 and initial tests look OK. Will run extended test (5 min) and report. Thank you. :pray:

Kai (eng-ml): If we can't repro locally, next step is to request a full heap/core dump from the customer's dedicated worker — Sam, can you ask them to run `rdx-support collect-debug --full-core --req rQ-20260316-9a1b2c3d` and allow us to pull securely?

Sam (support): Requested. Also asked them to capture the exact curl with concurrency using `hey` or `wrk` and paste the command.

SRE-Bot: ticket updated: INC-2026-2713 assigned to eng-runtime & eng-ml. Priority: P1 (customer impact, but mitigated by pin).

Priya (oncall): Good containment so far. Keep notes in the incident doc and ping here when we have a repro or a rollback plan.

Sam (support): Closing loop for now — AcmeCorp running on gpt-redwood-2.2. Will update if test fails. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
